english.title: Responsible person fail to comply with a regulation 14(4) notice served by appropriate agency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an owner, occupier or person in charge of land at **(..SPECIFY LAND..), failed to comply with a notice served by **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency, under regulation 14(4) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009 requiring you to

(A)_[operate an eel pass constructed or altered at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) under regulation 14 of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009 in accordance with conditions]_
(B)_[make alterations to an eel pass at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) constructed or altered under regulation 14 of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009]_
(C)_[make alterations to a fish pass at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) altered under regulation 14 of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(5) and 28(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009.
